challenge.method: Compare the contextual identifier cases and inspect which block ends and which declaration the condition uses.
challenge.results: The guide also shows continue() as a normal function call. In the invalid example continue ends the inner do block and would bypass a local read by the loop condition. The claim is scoped to the site commit and syntactically recognized statement.

limitations: Applies to a syntactically recognized continue statement in the pinned documentation. Named functions and variables called continue are separately described.
